dread the exam: Many students dread the exam because it covers so much material and decides which university they can enter.
許多學生害怕這場考試，因為範圍很廣，而且會決定他們能進哪所大學。
dread to think: I dread to think what would have happened if the firefighters had arrived a few minutes later.
我不敢想如果消防員晚到幾分鐘會發生什麼事。
dread going to work: Since his new boss started shouting at everyone, he has begun to dread going to work every Monday morning.
自從新老闆開始對每個人大吼之後，他每個星期一早上都害怕上班。
dress a wound: At the first-aid class, we learned how to clean and dress a wound so that it would not get infected.
在急救課上，我們學到如何清潔並包紮傷口，以免感染。
dress a salad: Wait until just before serving to dress a salad, or the lettuce will become soft and wet.
要等到上菜前才為沙拉淋醬，否則生菜會變得又軟又濕。
dress up the facts: The company tried to dress up the facts in its report, making its poor sales look much better than they were.
這家公司試圖在報告中美化事實，讓慘淡的銷售看起來比實際好得多。
dress down: On Fridays, employees are allowed to dress down and wear jeans and T-shirts to the office.
每到星期五，員工可以穿得隨便一點，穿牛仔褲和T恤上班。
drift apart: After they went to different universities, the two best friends slowly drifted apart and rarely talked anymore.
上了不同的大學之後，這兩個好朋友慢慢漸行漸遠，很少再聊天了。
drift off to sleep: Listening to the gentle rain outside, the baby finally drifted off to sleep in her mother's arms.
聽著窗外輕柔的雨聲，寶寶終於在媽媽懷裡漸漸入睡。
drift through life: Without any clear goals, he seemed to drift through life, changing jobs every few months.
他沒有任何明確的目標，似乎在虛度人生，每隔幾個月就換一次工作。
the conversation drifted: At first we talked about homework, but then the conversation drifted to our favorite TV shows.
一開始我們聊功課，但後來話題飄移到我們最喜歡的電視節目。
drift into crime: Social workers try to help teenagers who might otherwise drift into crime after dropping out of school.
社工努力幫助那些輟學後可能會誤入歧途的青少年。
drill students in grammar: Mr. Lin likes to drill students in grammar every morning, making them repeat sentence patterns again and again.
林老師喜歡每天早上反覆操練學生的文法，讓他們一再重複句型。
drill a hole: My dad used a power tool to drill a hole in the wall so that he could hang the painting.
我爸爸用電動工具在牆上鑽孔，好把那幅畫掛起來。
fire drill: During the fire drill this morning, all the students left the building calmly in less than three minutes.
在今天早上的消防演習中，所有學生在三分鐘內冷靜地離開大樓。
drill into someone: My parents have always tried to drill into me the importance of being honest and working hard.
我爸媽一直反覆向我灌輸誠實和努力的重要性。
drip with sarcasm: When I apologized for being late again, her reply seemed to drip with sarcasm, and I knew she was upset.
當我再次為遲到道歉時，她的回答充滿諷刺，我知道她不高興了。
drip with sweat: After running ten laps around the field, the players began to drip with sweat and were desperate for water.
繞操場跑了十圈後，球員們開始汗如雨下，急著想喝水。
drip-feed information: The government chose to drip-feed information about the new policy, releasing only small details each week.
政府選擇一點一點釋出新政策的資訊，每週只公布一些小細節。
drive someone crazy: The noise from the construction site next door is driving me crazy; I can't concentrate at all.
隔壁工地的噪音快把我逼瘋了，我完全無法專心。
drive up prices: The shortage of eggs has helped drive up prices at supermarkets all over the island this month.
雞蛋短缺這個月推升了全島超市的價格。
drive a hard bargain: The old shopkeeper drives a hard bargain, so it's not easy to get a discount from him.
那位老店主殺價很狠，所以很難從他那裡拿到折扣。
drive home a point: The teacher showed us real photos of plastic in the ocean to drive home a point about recycling.
老師給我們看海洋中塑膠垃圾的真實照片，把資源回收的觀點講透。
drive innovation: Competition between tech companies helps drive innovation, leading to faster and cheaper phones every year.
科技公司之間的競爭有助於推動創新，讓手機每年都更快、更便宜。
drive away customers: Rude service and dirty tables will drive away customers, no matter how delicious the food is.
不論食物多好吃，無禮的服務和髒亂的桌子都會趕跑顧客。
the driving force: Her love for animals was the driving force behind her decision to become a vet.
她對動物的熱愛是她決定成為獸醫背後的推動力。
drop a hint: My sister kept trying to drop a hint about what she wanted for her birthday, but I didn't notice.
我妹妹一直想暗示她生日想要什麼，但我都沒注意到。
drop a subject: Seeing that the question made him uncomfortable, I decided to drop a subject he clearly didn't want to discuss.
看到這個問題讓他不自在，我決定不再談這個他顯然不想討論的話題。
drop out of school: He had to drop out of school at sixteen to work and support his sick mother.
他十六歲時不得不輟學去工作，扶養生病的母親。
drop charges: After the man paid for all the damage, the shop owner decided to drop charges against him.
那名男子賠償所有損失後，店主決定撤銷對他的告訴。
prices dropped: After the new factory opened, prices dropped sharply, and more families could afford to buy the product.
新工廠開工後，價格大幅下跌，更多家庭買得起這項產品。
drop someone a line: When you get settled in Canada, please drop me a line and tell me how you're doing.
等你在加拿大安頓好，請寫封短信給我，告訴我你過得怎麼樣。
drop the ball: If we drop the ball on this project and forget to order the materials, everything will be delayed.
如果我們在這個專案上出包、忘了訂材料，一切都會延誤。
